session_context: Parallel session on the same prompt as lanes H78-A (shipped primary, HOLDOUT-DTI 0.1826 seed 20) and H78-MPC (second candidate, HOLDOUT-DTI 0.0977 seed 20). This lane must stay inside its single method paragraph below, must not copy either shipped raster, and must beat the repo holdout best (0.1826) to earn verdict promote.
method_paragraph_lane: H78-CS adds strike-following collinear-support features to the exact H78-A feature set and nothing else: for three independent-physics bands (det_elev topography, rtp magnetics, depth_to_base_surf basement depth), take the sigma=3 px strike-steered responses |Hnn| (across-strike curvature, line centre) and |gn| (across-strike step) already defined by lane H78-A, and integrate each along the local catalogue-strike tangent over straight segments of half-length 5 px (1.1 km) and 15 px (3.1 km), recording the path mean, plus for |Hnn| at 15 px the weaker-side half-mean min(mean_left, mean_right) which requires continuation on both sides of the pixel. The strike angle at the centre pixel only defines each segment (curvature ignored, disclosed). Same HistGradientBoosting learner, same training sample, same greedy >=2.8 px emitter with the <=3 px catalogue flank removed (B3), same budgets. The only difference between candidate and control is these 15 path-integral features, so the paired holdout difference isolates collinear support.
hypothesis: Faults are continuous strands kilometres long, so a true but faint unmapped strand accumulates steered ridge/step evidence coherently along its strike while the isolated texture that dominates per-pixel false positives (fan channels oblique to strike, short contacts, noise) does not; adding 1.1 km and 3.1 km along-strike path integrals of |Hnn| and |gn| on topography, magnetics and basement depth to the H78-A learner therefore raises kernel credit per emitted dot on withheld fault segments relative to the identical learner without them.
mechanism: Per-pixel detectors (H78-A sigma<=300 m, H78-MPC phase congruency) have no notion of line continuity. Integrating a non-negative line/step response along the regional strike direction is a matched filter for a straight strand: signal grows ~linearly with segment length, incoherent noise ~sqrt(length). The weaker-side statistic additionally requires the strand to continue through the pixel on both sides, suppressing strand endpoints, crossings and blobs.
named_non_fault_mimic: Pleistocene Lake Lahontan shorelines and beach ridges (long, straight-to-gently-curved, often range-front-parallel topographic lines with no basement/magnetic step); secondarily roads/rail alignments and bedrock strike ridges. The three-physics design (topography + magnetics + basement depth path integrals as separate features) exists so the learner can discount a purely topographic line.
why_missing_not_catalogued: The USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue is a compilation; the strands most likely missing are faint piedmont/intrabasin strands whose per-pixel scarp or potential-field step sits below a mapper's (or a per-pixel model's) local threshold but whose along-strike integrated evidence over 1-3 km is still coherent. Catalogue location is never a feature (strike orientation only, from visible faults in holdout), so the model is not paid to re-find mapped traces.
differs_from_repo_prior: H78-A: pointwise steered derivatives only (sigma 1.5/3 px), no integration along strike. H78-MPC: pointwise monogenic phase congruency + Frangi (sigma<=4 px), LOQO protocol, external bands; no strike-following path integrals. Family worm/radon lanes used continuity as standalone detectors or re-rankers of a fixed field (wormrank-d28 owner-report 0.2560 vs its D2.8 input 0.2600); none ablated path integrals as learner features against an identical control on this evaluator.

canary: single-feature symmetric AUC (max(AUC,1-AUC)) on withheld truth vs active background for all 118 features, same sampling as scripts/run_holdout.py; any feature >0.90 = leakage stop
uniqueness_rule: Spearman rho of candidate score surface vs each registry raster <=0.90 (checked before placement) AND fraction of final dots within 3 px of any registry dot set <=0.70 AND final-dot surface rho <=0.90. Registry = H19-5 solid, D2.8, H33-2-B2 (data/registry) + shipped H78-A primary, H78-A altB2, H78-MPC (docs/downloads). Breach = duplicate lane: log and verdict negative regardless of DTI.
